title: NIST AI RMF MEASURE 2.11 — Fairness and bias are evaluated and documented
description: The fairness-and-bias evaluation control within the MEASURE function of the NIST AI Risk Management Framework (AI RMF 1.0). The control_text below is a good-faith paraphrase pending verification against the primary NIST publication — hence its 'Community' confidence rather than 'Verified'.

history.note: Initial Phase 1 seed content. control_text is a paraphrase pending verification against the primary NIST publication.

framework_name: NIST AI Risk Management Framework (AI RMF 1.0)
control_text: Fairness and bias, as identified in the MAP function, are evaluated using disaggregated evaluation across relevant subpopulations, in collaboration with affected communities where practicable. The results of that evaluation — including identified disparities and the limitations of the methods used — are documented.

citations.title: Artificial Intelligence Risk Management Framework (AI RMF 1.0)
citations.publisher: National Institute of Standards and Technology (NIST)

relationships.reason: Satisfying this control requires producing a bias audit report as documentary evidence.
This control and this board question address the same underlying fairness/bias risk from different angles (technical requirement vs. oversight question).
